needs_atom.missing: 'You gain 1 life for each creature card milled this way': no quantity counts the creature cards among those the preceding mill moved. The canonical mill (MOVE_ZONE pop_order=TOP, journal_kind=MILL) writes no 'result' register (verbs.py _v_move_zone returns before any register write); a referent Selector must be CHOOSE/QConst(1) (convention C2), so QCount over it is at most 1; QProp THIS_WAY_COUNT reads only the TAP register; and MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN (library->graveyard, Creature) is turn-scoped, so it would also count creature cards milled earlier in the turn (stronger than printed). Needs a 'cards moved by the preceding step' set quantity with a filter (e.g. THIS_WAY_COUNT over the mill's moved set, filtered by Creature).
